@dogecoin_empire Mostly because of the cultural mixing pot that we are.
A fish sandwich could be many things, different types of fish halibut, catfish, shrimp even, but mostly HOT.
By prefacing it with "tuna" it denotes the type of fish "tuna" and the expectation that it is a COLD sandwich.
